---
title: "Deciles and quartiles of posterior means"
subtitle: "3.9 · after Kline, Rose and Walters (2024), Figures 2C and 6"
description: "Evaluation of fixed posterior-mean tiers on KRW's discordance and informativeness axes."
---

Quartiles and deciles split firms into nearly equal posterior-mean groups, keeping exact score ties together. Compare these fixed tiers with KRW's archived cards on discordance and informativeness.

## Numerical illustrations {#what-to-try}

- **Race quartiles, card λ .60.** Quartiles sit at DR .170 and I .419; the ringed card reaches lower DR (.168) and higher I (.434).
- **Race deciles, card λ .82.** Deciles move to DR .227 and I .455, while the selected card reaches .224 and .459.
- **Gender quartiles, card λ .64.** Under the signed male-name contact-gap target, quartiles give DR .198 and I .362; the card gives .191 and .388.
- **Gender deciles, card λ .80.** Deciles give DR .252 and I .404; the card gives .237 and .408. Not every λ improves both axes.

<details>
<summary>Reporting axes and archived-card provenance</summary>

KRW discuss deciles and quartiles in §IV.B (Figure 2C) and reporting possibilities in §V.E (Figure 6). The diamonds show the fixed tiers, while the curve joins cards that KRW selected using their archived probabilities. Here each card's coordinates are recomputed under the released signed-target probabilities without rerunning that search. KRW write τ̄ for informativeness.

</details>

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="In postrank"}
```r
x <- postrank::pr_case_krw$alternatives$race
b <- postrank::postrank_cuts(setNames(x$summaries$means[,1],x$entity_ids),x,postrank::postrank_settings(weights=c(race_signed=1),tau=.375,G_max=10),direction="descending",rule="quantile",G_b=4,method="posterior_mean")
b$evaluation[c("N","E_over_N","primary_risk")]
```
:::

Standalone: [deciles-quartiles](../../embed/deciles-quartiles.html), for example `?criterion=race&G=4&lambda=.60`.
